verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference API platform, so recurring job scheduling is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents any cron, schedule, or recurring-workflow feature. The standby service tier only lowers the price and priority of individual batch or background requests, and Reflex training is a one-off job you create and poll; neither runs anything on a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
